# OpenVR SDK

Official upstream: https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr

Pinned commit: `0924064316de3effbcd1acf1e309182a2deb1c05`

- `vendor/openvr_api.cs`: upstream `headers/openvr_api.cs`, unchanged.
- `dist/openvr_api.dll`: upstream `bin/win64/openvr_api.dll`, unchanged.
- `vendor/OpenVR-LICENSE.txt`: upstream `LICENSE` (also copied to dist).

Download source prefix: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ValveSoftware/openvr/0924064316de3effbcd1acf1e309182a2deb1c05/`

Use the matching managed bindings and DLL together. The SteamVR runtime must support the SDK interfaces; an older runtime may need an official SteamVR update.
